answer: Collective action escrow. Each agent that joins a multi-agent task pays an equal share into a joint escrow; payout releases only when at least half the participants independently submit a matching result before the dusk deadline, with disputes settled at the next dawn. A lone sybil cluster can fake agreement internally, but matching results must also survive an external yarrow-sampled audit: a random relic of prior task transcripts is replayed to each claimant, and inconsistent answers forfeit the whole escrow.
